implementation_notes: This is a provisional translation of an overview document. The act is primarily a promotion and framework law rather than a strict regulatory regime. Partial enforcement began 4 June 2025, full enforcement 1 September 2025. Binding obligations on business operators appear limited to cooperation duties. Detailed requirements will likely emerge via guidelines and the AI Basic Plan.
